# Ring of Jumping (`magic-items:ring-of-jumping`)
**Category:** [Rings](../equipment-categories/rings.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon | **Attunement:** Yes

Ring

While wearing this ring, you can cast Jump from it, but can target only yourself when you do so.
